report_identity.report_title: Shineroad International Holdings Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The group distributes food ingredients and food additives mainly in Mainland China, serving food and beverage manufacturers with supplier sourcing and R&D-supported solutions.
business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is recognised when goods are delivered; payment is generally due within 30 to 90 days from delivery, except new customers normally pay in advance.
business_notes: Major supplier/customer examples are disclosed in the chairman statement and management discussion.
Revenue comes from contracts with customers and all goods are transferred at a point in time.
